text:
sam: Starting the regional rollout now. Sequence: US -> EU -> APAC. Target image: engine:v2026.03.07. Window 00:30-03:00 UTC. Canary cadence: 5% for 8m, 20% for 12m, then full. APAC will stay pinned to engine:stable-2026-01 until we clear a hardware + capacity check. Post any anomalies here.

deploy-bot: Triggered US canary (slice=delta-us). Running checks: smoke, migrate-dryrun, routing-check. Dashboard: https://deploy.internal/d/rollouts/2790012345

yuko: Capacity readouts at kickoff:
US pool-us-prod: spare qps 79%, spare nodes 6/22, p95 baseline 90ms
EU pool-eu-prod: spare qps 64%, spare nodes 3/18, p95 baseline 118ms
APAC pool-apac-prod: spare qps 42%, spare nodes 1/12, p95 baseline 150ms
Note: APAC has been noisy last 24h; recommend hold unless spare qps >50% and >=2 spare nodes.

devin: APAC infra flagged: node apac-04 reported micro-throttles and a disk SMART warning. Infra ticket INC-8502 open. I recommend keeping APAC pinned.

infra_bot: apac-04 SMART alert at 2026-03-21T22:10Z. Memory fragmentation high across apac cluster. Assigned to infra-oncall.

ops_lead: Rollback triggers for tonight: (a) errors >0.8% over 3m, (b) sustained p95 >650ms for 10m, (c) any OOM/ECC/SMART errors on canary hosts. If triggered, rollback that region slice and escalate to #incidents.

sam: Roger. US -> observe 8m. If green, ramp to 20% then kick EU canary. APAC remains locked.

deploy-bot: US 5% canary smoke passed. Increasing to 20%. Metrics: error-rate 0.04%, p95 95ms, no OOMs.

yuko: US looks clean from synthetic traces. Pre-warming EU warm pool +1 GPU to avoid cold starts.

devin: EU pre-warm ACK. APAC keep pinned. If infra provides replacement node before 01:30 UTC we can re-evaluate.

deploy-bot: EU canary (slice=delta-eu) starting at 5%. Smoke checks queued. Logs: https://deploy.internal/logs/2790012345/eu

yuko: EU metrics after 10m at 5%: error-rate 0.09%, p95 120ms, spare qps 62%. No hardware alerts. Proceeding to 20% ramp.

sam: Good. Reminder to SRE: if p99 tail > 700ms for 3 consecutive samples, pause EU ramp and run quick diag.

mike: I pushed a short diagnostic job to EU canary pods to capture stack traces and hot functions if tail latency spikes. Hooked into the tracing dashboard.

deploy-bot: EU ramped to 20% and holding. US at full. APAC still pinned.

devin: Quick rollback snippet for ops if EU needs revert:

./deployctl region-rollback --region eu --slice delta-eu --to-image engine:stable-2026-01 --note "canary regressions"

ops_lead: Also keep this handy: rollback all regions command if multiple regions show regressions during the window. Use with caution.

sam: EU stable for 14m at 20%. No alerts. Given APAC node issues and low spare qps, we'll not attempt APAC tonight. I'll update the status page to call out APAC hold and link the infra ticket.

infra_bot: Update: apac-04 has been quarantined from the pool; replacement ETA 04:20 UTC. Spare nodes for APAC remain 0/12 until replacement.

yuko: Thanks. We'll schedule APAC attempt during a dedicated maintenance window tomorrow to avoid cross-zone warm-ups.

sam: Final state: US rolled, EU ramped to 20% and healthy, APAC pinned to engine:stable-2026-01 pending hardware replacement. If anyone sees anything off, tag @ops_lead and ping #incidents if rollback needed. Great job team. :thumbsup:
